confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Local prices were converted at an assumed rate of about R$5.5 per US$, not a live quote. Accommodation is the least certain because it varies by season and neighborhood; restaurant anchors are steadier. Cocktail and wine anchors were set using their typical price relationship to beer, since direct knowledge of those prices is weaker. The FX value comes from a search-result summary of the RBA exchange rates overview page, not a direct check of that page or table F11.1.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. The basis is general knowledge of large Brazilian coastal tourist-city pricing, with Copacabana, Ipanema and Botafogo as reference neighborhoods.
